verdict.rationale: Square documents the pieces an agent would use: registrable webhook event notifications with signature validation, a Payments API with card-on-file charging and idempotency keys for safe retries, Invoices and Subscriptions APIs, and an official MCP server whose catalog covers payments and invoices. None of the evidence specifically shows failed-payment events, built-in retry schedules, or dunning or reminder outreach, so the core monitor-retry-dunning loop is only implied. Missing for 10: documented failed-payment webhook events, native retry/dunning logic, automated payment-reminder outreach, independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent driving recovery.
